idea: Gasoline Price Spike Triggers Consumer Staples Outperformance

data.source: FRED series GASDESW (weekly average gasoline prices) via fred_series adapter

behavior: Sharp weekly spikes in gasoline prices above prior 4-week rolling average signal input cost inflation that rotates demand toward cheaper staples and away from discretionary goods.

market_impact.rationale: Staples outperform when consumers face rising transport/fuel costs and tighten discretionary spending.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly gasoline price exceeds 4-week moving average by >8%, enter long XLP
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 15 trading days or when gasoline price falls back within 3% of 4-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Gasoline prices fluctuate weekly with supply shocks and demand cycles; 8% spikes occur 3-4 times per quarter.

idea: Unemployment Claims Spike Fear Trade Into Healthcare

data.source: FRED series ICSA (initial claims weekly) via fred_series adapter

behavior: Weekly jobless claims spikes above 3-week moving average trigger flight-to-safety rotation into defensive healthcare stocks as investors price recession risk.

market_impact.rationale: Healthcare is defensive and non-cyclical; demand spikes during labor market deterioration.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly initial claims exceed 3-week MA by >12%, enter long XLV and short XLY
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or when claims fall back within 5% of 3-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Weekly claims data is volatile and noisy; 12% spikes above rolling mean occur 2-3 times per quarter.

idea: Freight Railroad Car Loading Collapse Signals Industrial Recession

data.source: FRED series RAILCARLD (railroad carloads weekly) via fred_series adapter

behavior: When weekly railroad carloads decline >5% from prior 8-week average, it signals collapsing industrial shipping demand and forward recession risk.

market_impact.rationale: Industrial production, construction, and materials demand all correlate with freight volume; sharp declines precede earnings misses.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly carloads < (8-week MA × 0.95), short XLI and long defensive XLU
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 12 trading days or when carloads rebound above 8-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Carload data is weekly and volatile; 5%+ drops from rolling mean occur 1-2 times per quarter.

idea: Heating Oil Demand Surge Signals Winter Energy Crisis

data.source: FRED series DHHNGSP (heating oil prices weekly) via fred_series adapter

behavior: Weekly heating oil prices spike >10% above 6-week moving average during winter months (Nov–Mar), signaling supply constraints or demand surge from cold snap.

market_impact.rationale: Energy sector benefits from price spikes driven by heating demand and supply tightness.

trade_logic.entry: During Q4–Q1, if heating oil price > 6-week MA × 1.10, enter long XLE
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 14 trading days or when price falls below 6-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Winter heating oil spikes are predictable; 10%+ moves occur 2-3 times per winter season.

idea: Google Trends Surge in 'Job Search' Keywords Signals Labor Anxiety

data.source: Google Trends weekly search interest for 'job search', 'resume writing', 'interview tips' via google_trends adapter

behavior: Spikes in job-search-related Google searches above 8-week rolling average indicate rising worker anxiety and voluntary separation risk, signaling wage pressure and consumer stress ahead.

market_impact.rationale: Rising job search activity precedes income disruption and consumer discretionary pullback.

trade_logic.entry: When job search query volume > 8-week MA × 1.15, short XLY and long XLP
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or when search volume returns below 8-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Job search trends spike seasonally and during recession cycles; 15%+ moves occur monthly.

idea: Copper Futures Price Collapse Signals Manufacturing Slowdown

data.source: Yahoo Finance daily copper futures prices via price_only adapter

behavior: When copper prices drop >4% in a single trading day, it signals sudden demand collapse or recession fears in manufacturing-heavy sectors, triggering bearish rotation.

market_impact.rationale: Copper is a leading indicator of industrial demand; sharp declines precede capex cuts and manufacturing weakness.

trade_logic.entry: If daily copper close < prior close × 0.96, short XLI and long XLU
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 8 trading days or when copper rebounds above 2-day prior close

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Copper futures are liquid and volatile; 4%+ daily swings occur 15-20 times per month.

idea: EV Charger Network Density Increase Signals Green Capex Acceleration

data.source: OpenChargeMap API daily charger station counts by region via openchargemap adapter

behavior: When weekly average EV charger installations exceed prior 12-week rolling mean by >8%, it signals government incentive acceleration or private capex surge supporting EV adoption.

market_impact.rationale: Charger expansion indicates semiconductor and software demand from EV infrastructure buildout.

trade_logic.entry: When 7-day average new chargers > 12-week MA × 1.08, enter long XLK
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 12 trading days or when charger installation rate falls below 12-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Charger deployments cluster around policy rollouts; 8%+ spikes occur 1-2 times per quarter.

idea: Commercial Real Estate Lease Default Surge via RSS News Volume

data.source: RSS feeds (CRE news, REIT blogs, commercial real estate site feeds) via rss_count adapter tracking mentions of 'lease termination', 'commercial property default', 'office vacancy'

behavior: Spikes in news mentions of commercial lease defaults or office vacancy above weekly rolling baseline signal distress in the CRE sector, triggering REIT volatility.

market_impact.rationale: Default surge news triggers REIT selloffs as dividend safety is questioned and refinancing risk rises.

trade_logic.entry: When daily CRE default mention count > 8-week MA × 1.25, short XLRE and long XLU
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 9 trading days or when mention count falls below 8-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: CRE stress news is recurrent; mention spikes occur monthly in volatile markets.

idea: Airline Load Factor Contraction Signals Travel Demand Collapse

data.source: BTS monthly airline load factor and available seat miles via bts_airline_load_factor adapter

behavior: When month-over-month airline load factor declines >2 percentage points, it indicates collapsing travel demand and recession pressure on discretionary consumer spending.

market_impact.rationale: Falling load factors precede hospitality, entertainment, and discretionary revenue declines.

trade_logic.entry: When LF(current month) < LF(prior month) - 2.0pp, short XLY and long XLP
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 15 trading days or when LF stabilizes above prior month level

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Airline load factor swings 1-3pp monthly; 2pp+ declines occur 3-4 times per year.

idea: Corporate Bond Spread Widening Signals Credit Stress Rotation

data.source: FRED series BAMLH0A0HYM2 (HY OAS) and BAMLC0A1CMBBBEY (BBB OAS) via fred_series adapter

behavior: When high-yield bond OAS widens >50bp in a single week above 4-week moving average, it signals deteriorating credit conditions and recession expectations.

market_impact.rationale: Widening credit spreads increase bank loss provisions and reduce lending capacity; financial sector underperforms.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly HY OAS increase > 50bp and close > 4-week MA + 25bp, short XLF and long XLV
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 11 trading days or when OAS tightens back below 4-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Credit spreads widen sharply 2-3 times per quarter during volatility episodes; 50bp+ moves are frequent.
